Package com.irurueta.units

Class EnergyConverter

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.units.EnergyConverter
public final class EnergyConverter extends Object
Does energy conversions to different units. To prevent loss of accuracy, conversion should only be done as a final step before displaying energy measurements.
